ActionInHand.description:
The action the human's executor has in hand, its occurrence in the task's expansion, and its progress in
ticks.
ActionInHand.title: ActionInHand

ActionRef.description: A grounded action: its schema's name and its bindings.
ActionRef.title: ActionRef

AfterActionTrigger.description:
After the action (its schema's name) of the entry's expansion completes; `occurrence` its 0-based occurrence,
None when it occurs once.
AfterActionTrigger.title: AfterActionTrigger

AgentTick.description:
An agent at the tick: its position, and the unit direction of its most recent step that moved it (None before
it has moved), computed from its own positions.
AgentTick.title: AgentTick

Appearance.description: A domain's scene appearance: per object type its look; the agents' figures. Every field has a default.
Appearance.title: Appearance

AtCut.description: Inside the action (its occurrence), `done` of its ticks executed.
AtCut.title: AtCut

BuildFailure.description: A model that could not be built from the choice; no sim-run exists and no log pair is written.
BuildFailure.title: BuildFailure

Catalogue.description:
What can be chosen: per domain its layouts, setups and scenarios, and the run options with their values and
defaults; `default_choice` is the run file's.
Catalogue.title: Catalogue

Current.description:
The answer to current: the current sim-run with its tick updates, or the current view, or neither (both
None). At most one is set.
Current.title: Current

DomainEntry.description: A domain: what can be chosen in it, and its scene appearance (the defaults where it states none).
DomainEntry.title: DomainEntry

DuringActionTrigger.description: A cut `time` (as written, ISO-8601) into the action.
DuringActionTrigger.title: DuringActionTrigger

Entered.description: A script entry's task pushed on the empty stack.
Entered.title: Entered

EntryPosition.description: Which entry of the script: its part and its index there.
EntryPosition.title: EntryPosition

Extent.description: A size: the extent along x and along y.
Extent.title: Extent

FixedObject.description: A fixed object of the layout, at its position for the whole sim-run (an override applied).
FixedObject.title: FixedObject

FixedObjectContents.description:
A fixed object that holds movable objects at the tick, with them in their order of arrival (at the start, the
setup's order; two arriving on one tick, the setup's order).
FixedObjectContents.title: FixedObjectContents

FixedStateLook.description: The look of a fixed object while `state` holds for it.
FixedStateLook.title: FixedStateLook

FixedTypeLook.description: A fixed object type's look, and its looks by state in order (the first whose state holds is drawn).
FixedTypeLook.title: FixedTypeLook

HumanActivity.description:
What a human's executor is doing at the tick, from its record: the stack, top first; the action in hand; the
stack's transitions on the tick; the script's entries still open (ordinary, then closing).
HumanActivity.title: HumanActivity

HumanScript.description:
A human's script: the ordinary entries of the priority list in written order, its repeatable entries, its
closing part, and whether it depends on the robot.
HumanScript.title: HumanScript

LayoutEntry.description:
A layout: its id, its title (stale in older layouts), and its notes, the free text of the layout file that says
what the room is for (None when it has none).
LayoutEntry.title: LayoutEntry

LayoutView.description:
The view of a layout (the space, the areas, the fixed objects) and, with a setup chosen, of the setup at its
start. No sim-run, no agent, no tick.
LayoutView.title: LayoutView

Left.description: A task left the top of the stack, or was pushed down (suspended).
Left.title: Left

LevelOption.description: A run option that is a number strictly between 0 and 1.
LevelOption.title: LevelOption

LimitOption.description: A run option that is a limit: a whole number, at least `minimum`, or no limit (None).
LimitOption.title: LimitOption

LimitValue.description: A limit's value; None: no limit.
LimitValue.title: LimitValue

MovableObject.description:
A movable object of the setup: its home container and, where the domain determines one, its designated
destination. Where it is at a tick is the tick update's.
MovableObject.title: MovableObject

MovableShape.description: The forms of a movable object.
MovableShape.title: MovableShape

MovableStateLook.description: The look of a movable object while `state` holds for it.
MovableStateLook.title: MovableStateLook

MovableTypeLook.description: A movable object type's look, and its looks by state in order (the first whose state holds is drawn).
MovableTypeLook.title: MovableTypeLook

NowTrigger.description: A live event, fired on the tick it is applied.
NowTrigger.title: NowTrigger

ObjectState.description: A declared state that holds; `object` None for a fact about no object.
ObjectState.title: ObjectState

OneOfOption.description: A run option that takes one value of a closed list.
OneOfOption.title: OneOfOption

RunDescription.description:
Everything constant in one sim-run, sent when its model is built: the triple, the run options as the
screen-user stated them and as the model applies them (an option set off by another shows here), and the world.
RunDescription.title: RunDescription

RunEnd.description: The sim-run's end: why, and the entries still open of each script that depends on the robot.
RunEnd.title: RunEnd

RunTick.description:
The facts of the sim-run at the tick that are neither the world's nor the robot's mind's. `finished_at`: the
first tick at which every human's script had ended (every entry closed, the stack empty) and every robot's task
pool was empty (the tick of its empty-pool log line); None before. Once set, it is kept.
RunTick.title: RunTick

ScenarioEntry.description:
A scenario with its two bindings: the one setup it binds and its reference layouts (the first is the one a
run takes when it names no layout). A run on another layout of the domain is valid and never a baseline.
ScenarioEntry.title: ScenarioEntry

SetupEntry.description: A setup: its id and its notes, the free text of the setup file (None when it has none).
SetupEntry.title: SetupEntry

SetupView.description:
A setup's part of a view: its movable objects in the setup's order, the fixed objects that hold them at the
start (each with them in the setup's order), and the object states that hold at the start.
SetupView.title: SetupView

ShapeKind.description: The forms of a fixed object, drawn over its footprint.
ShapeKind.title: ShapeKind

SimRunChoice.description:
The screen-user's choice of a sim-run: the domain, the layout, the scenario (its setup is the scenario's) and
a value for every run option the catalogue declares.
SimRunChoice.title: SimRunChoice

SimRunHistory.description:
A sim-run with every tick update it has given, in order: the start's first, then one per step (the last
carrying the end when it has ended). The page derives from the sequence what a single tick does not hold (the
display places, T-viz 1a (iii)), so that a reload keeps the picture.
SimRunHistory.title: SimRunHistory

SimRunRef.description: The body of a request on one sim-run (step, reset).
SimRunRef.title: SimRunRef

SimRunState.description:
A sim-run as the page needs it to draw: its run description and its latest tick update (the start's before
the first step). The answer to choose and reset.
SimRunState.title: SimRunState

Started.description: A task pushed on the stack by an event; `where` on the task below it, None on an empty stack.
Started.title: Started

StepRefusal.description:
A step or a reset refused: the sim-run is not the current one, it has ended (a step only), or a step of it is
under way.
StepRefusal.title: StepRefusal

StillOpen.description: An entry still open where the script stops being followed (a script that depends on the robot).
StillOpen.title: StillOpen

SwitchOption.description: A run option that is on or off.
SwitchOption.title: SwitchOption

TaskRef.description:
A task instance: its schema's name and its bindings; `label` is the framework's derived label, the text the
logs show.
TaskRef.title: TaskRef

TimelineWindow.description: A timeline fact holds on the ticks [start, until); `until` None: to the run's end.
TimelineWindow.title: TimelineWindow

ViewChoice.description: The body of a view request: a layout of the domain, and optionally a setup.
ViewChoice.title: ViewChoice

ViewRefusal.description: A view refused: a sim-run that has been stepped is current, and the choices are locked until a reset.
ViewRefusal.title: ViewRefusal

WorldTick.description: The world at the tick. Every movable object is in exactly one of `fixed_object_contents` and `carried`.
WorldTick.title: WorldTick
